caption: The drawing depicts an ornate balcony railing in a linear, black-and-white pen style. The railing consists of a repeating pattern of decorative elements, including interconnected X-shapes and vertically oriented motifs with symmetrical, stylized floral or leaf designs at the intersections. Circular medallions are present near the top corners of the railing, each featuring additional intricate internal designs. The top rail of the balcony displays a band of scrolling, vine-like foliage, while the lower section has a geometric pattern of interlocking rectangles and squares. Shaded hatching is used to create texture and contrast within the decorative elements. Behind the railing, the background contains the faint outlines of architectural elements, such as a wall and closed window shutters, also rendered in simple line work. The entire composition is set against a plain, light-colored background.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Railing
